name: Rubescent-Pediment
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are perpetual storm systems, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Extremophile bacteria thrive in the mineral seeps, painting slow, living terraces.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Whoever controls medicinal compounds controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
